Test Method: Potentiodynamic Polarization. The specimens were activated at the cathodic potential of 2700 mV saturated calomel electrode (SCE) for 10 min.
Comments: Specimens, with an area of 0.95 cm2, were pretreated by grinding on emery paper down to 600 grit, polished with diamond paste to 1 mm, ultrasonically cleaned in ethanol, and dried in hot air. The electrolyte was deaerated by Ar bubbling for 2 h before exposure.
